subject: Arbor Health: keystore inventory & provisioning timeline
messages:
From: Amy Cheng <amy.cheng@arborhealth.com>
To: irene_choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@arborhealth.com
Date: Tue, 10 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: keystore inventory + provisioning timeline (SOC2 scope)

Hi Irene —

Arbor Health's SOC 2 auditor is scoped to verify encryption controls for PHI at rest and in transit. Can you provide the following for Redwood-managed tenants (redact customer PII where applicable):

- CSV inventory of active encryption keys (key id, key type, creation date, parent/wrapping key id, KMS/HSM location, algorithm, key purpose)
- Provisioning and activation logs for keys (audit entries showing who provisioned/unwrapped/activated within the last 12 months; if 12 months is too large, a 90-day sample is acceptable — please call out the sampling window)
- HSM attestation or model/firmware details for any keys backed by HW (we need vendor+model and tamper/state notes)
- Access matrix (which roles can request key operations, who holds custodial privileges, separation of duties notes)
- Short description of emergency key compromise procedure (revocation/rotation and tenant notification cadence)

Target: QA would like to ingest these artifacts by COB next Friday (2028-04-17). Let me know if you need a narrower format or if redaction assistance is required.

Thanks,
Amy Cheng
Senior InfoSec Analyst — Arbor Health
amy.cheng@arborhealth.com
From: irene_choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Amy Cheng <amy.cheng@arborhealth.com>
Cc: rafael_mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Apr 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: keystore inventory + provisioning timeline (SOC2 scope)

Amy —

Thanks for the clear list. We're happy to provide a package. Quick notes on scope and timelines:

- Inventory: we can generate a CSV containing key_id, key_type (symmetric/asymmetric), creation_date (UTC), parent_key_id (if wrapped), kms_provider (CloudVault KMS), hsm_backed (SafeHSM v3 where applicable), algorithm, and usage tag (at-rest/transport).
- Provisioning logs: we will extract audit trail entries from our vault for the requested window. For tenant privacy we will redact tenant identifiers; redaction rules will be documented in the readme included in the bundle.
- HSM info: SafeHSM v3 firmware version, FIPS mode, and manufacturer statement can be attached as a PDF artifact (we will request the vendor attestation if not already on file).
- Access matrix & SOD: we'll provide an XLS with role→capability mapping and the current custodial/approval workflow (including our emergency ops escalation).
- Emergency compromise procedure: short playbook + sample notification template.

We expect to deliver a first tranche (inventory + 90-day log sample + access matrix summary) by Fri 2028-04-15 EOD, and the vendor attestation / full log extract by Mon 2028-04-17 if vendor redaction is needed. Rafael — can you confirm we can share the SafeHSM manufacturer PDF (redacted) and a 90-day log sample?

cc: Lauren to handle any contract/PO gating for attachments.

Best,
Irene Choi
Senior Compliance Manager — Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.ai
From: Amy Cheng <amy.cheng@arborhealth.com>
To: irene_choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@arborhealth.com
Date: Fri, 13 Apr 2028 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: keystore inventory + provisioning timeline (SOC2 scope)

Thanks Irene — that timeline works. Couple of clarifications from audit:

- For the provisioning logs, the auditor prefers an unbroken audit chain for any key lifecycle actions (create/import/unwrap/rotate/revoke). If you must sample, please identify the sampling methodology and include contiguous windows (not random scattered rows).
- On redaction: please remove any tenant names/tenant IDs and replace with pseudonyms (Tenant-01), but keep the full audit trail structure and timestamps intact.
- Emergency compromise: please explicitly call out the timeline to revoke/wrap and whether we push notifications automatically or manually (and the expected customer-facing timing).

If you can call out those items in the README that accompanies the bundle, we can mark this as ingestion-ready.

Regards,
Amy
From: irene_choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Amy Cheng <amy.cheng@arborhealth.com>
Cc: rafael_mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>, lauren_bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 17 Apr 2028 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: keystore inventory + provisioning timeline (SOC2 scope) — artifacts delivered

Amy —

Attached is the compliance bundle per your request. Summary of contents and key notes:

- keystore_inventory_20280416.csv (attached): full active-key inventory for tenant-scoped keys. Fields: key_id, key_class, created_at (UTC), parent_key_id (if wrapped), kms_provider, hsm_backed (boolean), algorithm, usage_tags. We replaced tenant identifiers with pseudonyms (Tenant-01 → Tenant-12).
- provisioning_log_excerpt_20280416.txt (attached): contiguous 90-day sample (2028-01-10 → 2028-04-09) showing create/import/activate/rotate/revoke events with actor principal and source IP. Full 12-month extracts are available on request; we truncated for privacy and file-size.
- hsm_manufacturer_attestation_safehsm_v3.pdf (attached): vendor-supplied statement for SafeHSM v3; redacted serials per vendor terms. Firmware: 3.2.1; FIPS mode: enabled.
- kms_access_matrix_20280416.xlsx (attached): role→capability mapping. Custodial keys are provisioned via an approval workflow requiring two distinct approvers (operator + security reviewer).
- rotation_policy_redacted.pdf (attached): rotation cadence (90 days for tenant data keys, annual for master wrapping keys), automatic rotation automation via controller, emergency rotation checklist included.

Notes on emergency compromise procedure (excerpt):
- Immediate action: revoke affected key material and trigger tenant-specific key-wrapping using latest master KEK within 15 minutes (ops automated playbook).
- Notification: internal stakeholders alerted immediately; customer notification template sent within 4 business hours, with remediation updates every 24 hours until resolved.
- Auditability: all actions are recorded in immutable audit logs stored with SHA-256 digests and retained per our policy (90 days for raw logs; archived 7 years in encrypted backups).

Access to the bundle (redacted artifacts) is available at: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cExampleLink (HubSpot ticket HAB-4382). If the auditor needs expanded windows or the original (non-redacted) vendor attestation under an NDA, we can coordinate vendor release; DocuSign link for the delegation form is here: https://docusign.net/ABC123-delegation.

Attachment stubs: keystore_inventory_20280416.csv (csv), provisioning_log_excerpt_20280416.txt (text), hsm_manufacturer_attestation_safehsm_v3.pdf (pdf), kms_access_matrix_20280416.xlsx (xlsx), rotation_policy_redacted.pdf (pdf).

Let me know if you need additional formatting or a combined TAR for ingestion into your tooling.

Best regards,
Irene Choi
Senior Compliance Manager — Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.ai
